book.guestLead: With a free account you can find your voucher and your bookings again. After logging in you come back to this hour.

book.rulesHold: Once you continue, we hold the spot for you for {minutes} minutes while you pay.

book.working: We are opening the secure Stripe payment page. One moment.

book.termsNote: By reserving you agree to the <link>terms</link>.

salonPage.unverifiedMeaning: GatVuller has not checked this business’s company details yet.

bookings.metaDescription: Your upcoming appointments, vouchers and reviews.
bookings.emptyPastBody: Appointments that are over, cancelled or expired will appear here.
bookings.pendingNote: Payment not confirmed yet. As soon as Stripe confirms, your voucher appears here. If it does not, the spot is released on its own and nothing is charged.
bookings.noShowNote: You did not show up, so the amount was not refunded.
bookings.refundedNote: {amount} goes back to your payment method. This can take a few working days.
bookings.cancelUntil: Free cancellation until {deadline}. You get the full amount back.
bookings.cancelClosed: Free cancellation is no longer possible.

voucher.qrLabel: QR code for your booking. Show it at the desk.

status.stillWaiting: Bear with us. Confirming a payment sometimes takes half a minute or more. You can leave this screen open.
status.slowDetail: Was the amount charged? Then you will get your voucher by email and find it under My bookings. If nothing was charged, you do not need to do anything: the spot is released on its own.

review.verifiedHint: The business confirmed your visit: your review will carry the label “Confirmed visit”.
review.unverifiedHint: The business did not confirm your visit, so your review will not carry the label “Confirmed visit”.
review.windowHint: You can leave a review up to {days} days after your appointment.
review.hiddenNote: Your review has been hidden by the GatVuller team (for example after a report) and does not count towards the average. Think that is a mistake? Please contact us.

report.messageHint: What is going on? Do not share sensitive details about yourself or others.
report.messageRequired: For “Something else”, add a short explanation (at least 5 characters).
report.sentDetail: We read every report, but we do not always reply personally. Urgent problem with a booking? Use the contact form.

copyCode.failed: Copying failed. Write the code down.
